description: Generated Go client code for Kubernetes RBAC v1 API, providing client methods for roles, role bindings, cluster roles, and cluster role bindings within the rbac.authorization.k8s.io group.

classes.name: RbacV1Client
classes.description: Client implementation for interacting with RBAC v1 resources in Kubernetes.

methods.name: ClusterRoles
methods.description: Returns an interface for managing cluster roles.

methods.name: ClusterRoleBindings
methods.description: Returns an interface for managing cluster role bindings.

methods.name: Roles
methods.description: Returns an interface for managing roles within a namespace.

methods.name: RoleBindings
methods.description: Returns an interface for managing role bindings within a namespace.

methods.name: NewForConfig
methods.description: Creates a new RBAC v1 client from a given REST config.

methods.name: NewForConfigAndClient
methods.description: Creates a new RBAC v1 client from a REST config and HTTP client.

methods.name: NewForConfigOrDie
methods.description: Creates a new RBAC v1 client from a REST config, panics on error.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new RBAC v1 client from an existing REST client.

methods.name: setConfigDefaults
methods.description: Sets default values for REST config for RBAC client.

methods.name: RESTClient
methods.description: Returns the REST client used for communication with the API server.
